request.text: Prominent close dry foley of a mushroom canopy folding and reopening over a nest. 0-.9s: soft leathery wings sweep down with a papery flap. .9-1.6s: hollow ceramic vents and wood collar seat with clear clacks. 1.6-3.1s: wings steadily lift, a wood valve turns. 3.1-3.6s: one small bellows compresses with an audible short air puff and firm wood tick. Warm tactile foreground game sound. No voice, music, ambience or reverb.
